text:
Nora: quick PSA  demo traffic caused the gw to block on admission and we returned a cascade of 503s. We should introduce a nonblocking contract at the ingress.
Ben: paste of the tiny trace:
```
2026-07-12T09:22:11Z ingress-gw WARN req=aa1 hold=admission wait=1120ms
2026-07-12T09:22:11Z admission ERR req=aa1 reconcile=slow
2026-07-12T09:22:11Z ingress-gw ERR req=aa1 respond=503
```
Kofi: two candidate boundaries: (1) ingress early-fail when admission slow (keeps p99 tight), (2) speculative credits (short-lived "grace passes") granted by admission enabling gw to accept request immediately and reconcile later.
Eliza: I like "grace passes" name. Pros: preserves client latency. Cons: bookkeeping for revokes, refunds, and abuse surfaces. Need clear limits per-tenant.
Nora: proto sketch (rough):
```
message GracePass { enum Mode { APPROVE=0; GRACE=1; DENY=2 } Mode mode = 1; string pass_id = 2; int32 grace_ms = 3; int32 priority_hint = 4; }
```
Kofi: runtime behavior: if GRACE -> gw tags request grace=true, enqueues low-priority work so confirmed grants can preempt. Store pass_id for later reconcile. Add short in-gw cache (key=tenant:route, ttl=600ms) to reduce stampede.
Ben: billing: prefer charge-on-issue + reconciliation refunds when revoke occurs. Simpler billing and discourages abuse; refunds must be auditable.
Eliza: telemetry plan: grace_issued, grace_revoked, grace_revoked_rate, grace_duration_ms_hist, reconcile_refunds_total, per-route p50/p95/p99 with grace tag; alert if revoked_rate > 1% over 5m.
Nora: experiment plan: gate GRACE to low-cost routes (embeddings, short completions). Canary: staging smoke -> 1% prod for 48h -> 5% for 72h -> evaluate. Also run synthetic burst sim to validate fairness before canary.
Kofi: owners: Nora RFC + proto, Ben refunds + billing, Eliza telemetry + alerts, Kofi gateway + cache + simulator. I'll open RFC and link PRs.
Ben: quick +1. Nora: will follow up with a tiny spike test and a runbook for graceful revokes. :thumbsup:
